title: Value-owned graph edit history and logical-identity document diff are ledgered

needles: graph edit history refuses to undo over an unrecorded edit
graph document diff compares by logical identity, not NodeId
graph edit history refuses a restore that would leave a node unresolved

installed_sdk.rationale: GraphEditHistory and diff_graph_documents are public host APIs over saved-identity v6 documents; they hold no pointer into a live graph and the diff is data-only.

needles: graph edit history undoes and redoes by value

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: pulp graph diff reads two bounded saved documents and reports their logical-identity differences; it never loads plugin code or writes files.

needles: graph diff compares saved documents by logical identity
graph CLI success code and fmt use the C++ spelling

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No MCP operation, schema, or handler is added; the pulp_graph tool does not expose diff.

live_product_control.rationale: History restores through GraphSerializer on the caller's thread; it adds no runtime operation or executor authority.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: No design-time capability or agent manifest entry is added.
